_comment: Mutation measurement of the role workbench page's components and hooks: the page, its people-as-rows grid, the candidate panel, rule editor, controls, filters, investigation bar and save actions, against the folder's mount and hook tests. The logic files are stryker.workbench.config.json. Split from it (Nov 2026, #1548). MEASURED (Nov 2026, run 42604306292), before this split: 62.63% over 4,100 mutants in 54 minutes 50 seconds of the job's 60, with only 9 of the folder's 17 tests listed -- workbench.transposed.js (12%), workbench.permissions.js (26%) and usePageVirtualRows.js (6%) were scored against tests that never call them, and every logic mutant paid for a full page mount. MEASURED (run 42611981685) with the people-as-columns view still in scope: 66.67% over 2,224 mutants in 53 minutes of the job's 60, so that view moved to stryker.workbenchcolumns.config.json. Same mutator settings. NOT YET MEASURED in this shape: no `break` until a run gives a number to set it a few points under.
